en.title: N
en.summary: The letter N is the fourteenth letter of the Romanian alphabet.

sections.title: Sound of letter N
paragraphs: The name of this letter is /n/. Its main sound is the sound /n/ as in the word (nor) /now/, which means night. This letter has two sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: For the first sound, place the tip of your tongue against your upper gum. Let the air pass through your nose while your vocal cords vibrate. For the second sound, press the back of your tongue against the soft roof of your mouth. Keep the air flowing through your nose. Put a finger beside your nose to feel it vibrate.

sections.title: Reading rules
paragraphs: In most places, this letter makes the sound /n/ as in (nou) /now/. Before the letters c or g, it makes the sound /ŋ/ as in (bancă) /ˈbaŋ.kə/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: You may drop the nose airflow too early at the end of a word. Keep your tongue pressed firmly in place and let the sound ring clearly through your nose, just like in the English word sun.
